caption: The drawing depicts an enclosed garden scene viewed from an elevated, isometric perspective. The area is surrounded by a pale gray wooden fence that encloses two main sections: an elaborately patterned garden on the left and an open grass lawn on the right. The garden section is filled with various geometric and floral bed designs in symmetrical arrangements, using colors such as green, yellow, blue, and red, bordered by pinkish-brown walkways. Some beds are rectangular, while others are curved, triangular, or shaped like stylized flowers, with occasional small green bushes or trees at corners. Adjacent to the garden and lawn, at the right edge of the scene, stands a two-story building with a red tiled roof and a yellow gabled facade. In front of the building, a figure wearing a hat and blue clothing is visible. Near the bottom left corner inside the fence, there is a black gallows with a hanging rope. The entire composition is drawn with clear outlines and muted colors on a light beige background.
title: Stuyvesant's Great House
